query: INSERT INTO social_media_streamer_settings (streamer_login, approval_mode, timezone, updated_at, updated_by) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, $4) ON CONFLICT (streamer_login) DO UPDATE SET approval_mode = EXCLUDED.approval_mode, timezone = EXCLUDED.timezone, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by
